meta.title: About
meta.description: Vkusno is a home-style Russian kitchen in Dubai, founded in 2021. Five kitchens, delivery, pickup, and casual self-service.

title: About

serve.title: How we serve
serve.kitchens: Five kitchens in Dubai. Each one has its own address and hours.
serve.order: We deliver and we offer pickup. You order in a delivery app, or directly from the Arjan kitchen.
serve.seating: Some kitchens have casual self-service seating. We do not offer full table service.

halal: Our food is halal. The menu has no pork and no alcohol.
note: Vkusno does not take catering orders.
